pending.title: Understanding how people (actually) make decisions
pending.summary: A free, beginner-friendly online introduction to behavioural science for people whose work depends on getting others to act: campaigners, corporate relations specialists and communications staff. Covers how people make decisions, the two systems of thinking, a practical framework for building stronger messages, and a small set of decision-making biases you can apply straight away. Examples include getting a meeting, winning support for a cage-free policy, or getting someone to sign a petition.
pending.when: Wednesday 2 December 2026. Two live sessions: 08:00 UK time (13:30 IST) or 15:00 UK time (20:30 IST). Each lasts 1 hour 30 minutes. Registrants get a recording afterwards.

pending.organiser: Not named on the registration page; if you can't confirm the organiser, leave it out rather than guessing.

pending.title: Woofly: Maneka Gandhi's vegan dog food brand
pending.summary: Maneka Gandhi has launched Woofly, a vegan dog food made by Compassion Foods, a company she owns. According to Business Line, it was unveiled at CINEKIND on World Animal Day (October 4), costs ₹40 for a 100-gram packet that expands to about 300 grams when mixed with water, is made at a vegan-only facility in Jaipur, and is to be sold on Zepto, Amazon, Flipkart and the brand's own website. She said profits would support People for Animals, giving it a steady source of income.
pending.editorNote: Confirm the launch year and date before publishing (the republished article carries no date). If it launched on October 4, 2026, present it as a recent launch the docket had not yet covered. Add any newer Woofly news (availability, reviews) and Woofly's own site if you find it.
pending.placement: Movement watch, tag 'People for Animals · Woofly' (art: food). One line in the WhatsApp summary.

pending.title: Indian Animal Studies Collective (IASC)
pending.summary: An interdisciplinary academic collective studying animals in India through critical animal studies, run by scholars including Anu Pande (EFLU Hyderabad) and Susan Haris (BITS Pilani). It hosts the 'Table Talk' conversation series, the 'Between Theory and Praxis' podcast and panels such as 'Fifty Years of Project Tiger'.
pending.editorNote: Introduce the collective once, as a short 'worth following' item for readers interested in the scholarship on animals in India. Lead with any new event, call for papers or Table Talk episode if there is one; otherwise describe what it does in the house style.
